market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH at ~$2,400 on May 6 2026 would need to drop ~38% to $1,500 by Dec 31. ETH has been more volatile than BTC and recently consolidated around $2,300-2,500. An 8-month drawdown of that magnitude is plausible only with a significant macro shock or crypto-specific crisis.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Crypto sector correlation with risk-off macro events
